description: The line plot illustrates the comparison of two different methods, SMoE Validating and SimSMoE Validating, in terms of their performance over a series of training steps. The x-axis, labeled "Training Steps," is on a linear scale and ranges from 0 to 50, with each tick representing 10 training steps. The y-axis, labeled "BPC," is also on a linear scale and ranges from 1.2 to 2.2, with each tick representing an increment of 0.2. The SMoE Validating line, represented by a black line with square markers, starts at a BPC of approximately 2.2 and shows a sharp decline to a BPC of around 1.4 within the first 10 training steps. It then gradually decreases and stabilizes, maintaining a BPC close to 1.4 for the remainder of the training steps. The SimSMoE Validating line, depicted by a magenta line with diamond markers, begins at a BPC of approximately 2.2 and follows a similar sharp decline to a BPC of around 1.4 within the first 10 training steps. However, unlike the SMoE Validating line, the SimSMoE Validating line shows a slight increase in BPC after the initial decline, reaching a BPC of approximately 1.6, before it stabilizes and maintains a BPC close to 1.4 for the rest of the training steps.
